I have only this quarter-hectare plot, so I must work it carefully. I will apply the chemical fertilizer I get through the government subsidy program, and I will also spread manure from our animals because the soil needs strength. I will plant the improved maize seed I kept from last season, but I cannot afford pesticides or hired workers, so my children and I will weed and harvest everything by hand when the rains come. We have no way to irrigate, so we depend entirely on rainfall.
